participation.context: Kept the rehearsal to doors, and named noon.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Refused a new matter before dinner.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Took his door and added nothing.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You ran the entrances. You gave Kemp nothing new, and you did not tell him the king.

participation.context: Read the title and did not cross.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You had the title French Comedy, and you did not go to it.

participation.context: Went on, and left the morning out of it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the afternoon to what was set down.
participation.name: John Heminges

story.body: You played the afternoon. You did not tell Kemp the king, and you did not name a sum.
